qualification.details: Qualification: A master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed from a recognized University; A Ph.D. Degree in concerned / allied / relevant discipline(s) in the institutions concerned with evidence of published work; A minimum score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based on Performance based Appraisal system (PBAS) as set in the regulation in Appendix-III for direct recruitment of principals in colleges; A minimum of 10 Research Publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals; A minimum of 110 Research Score as per Appendix-II at Table - 2 (UGC guideline 18.07.2018) Experience: Associate Professor/ Professor with total experience of fifteen years of teaching/research /administration in universities, colleges and other institutions of higher education Age limit: Maximum 55 years (as on 1 January 2026) | Other conditions: | Minimum API score based on PBAS as set in Appendix-III for direct recruitment of principals in colleges Minimum of 10 research publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals Minimum of 110 Research Score as per Appendix-II at Table-2 (UGC guideline 18.07.2018)

how_to_apply: Apply in the prescribed proforma issued by the DHE, Assam.
Include biodata and all self-attested testimonials from HSLC onwards.
Attach a demand draft of Rs. 5000/- drawn in favour of Principal, Suren Das College, Hajo payable at State Bank of India, Hajo Branch.
Submit to the Chairperson, Governing Body, Suren Das College (Autonomous), P.O.- Hajo, Dist.- Kamrup (Assam), Pin-781102 within 15 days of publication (13-11-2026).
Make sure it reaches by 5 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: A master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grade in a point scale wherever grading system is followed from a recognized University; A Ph.D. Degree in concerned / allied / relevant discipline(s) in the institutions concerned with evidence of published work; A minimum score as stipulated in the Academic Performance Indicator (API) based on Performance based Appraisal system (PBAS) as set in the regulation in Appendix-III for direct recruitment of principals in colleges; A minimum of 10 Research Publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals; A minimum of 110 Research Score as per Appendix-II at Table - 2 (UGC guideline 18.07.2018) Experience: Associate Professor/ Professor with total experience of fifteen years of teaching/research /administration in universities, colleges and other institutions of higher education Age limit: Maximum 55 years (as on 1 January 2026) Other conditions: Minimum API score based on PBAS as set in Appendix-III for direct recruitment of principals in colleges Minimum of 10 research publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals Minimum of 110 Research Score as per Appendix-II at Table-2 (UGC guideline 18.07.2018)

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Suren Das College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for Suren Das College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Prescribed proforma issued by the DHE, Assam) and send it to Chairperson, Governing Body, Suren Das College (Autonomous), P.O.- Hajo, Dist.- Kamrup (Assam), Pin-781102, by post, to reach by 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for Suren Das College Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: All candidates: Rs. 5000 (Non-refundable) by demand draft.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 55 years (as on 1 January 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Master's degree with at least 55% marks (or equivalent grade) from a recognized University; Ph.D. in concerned/allied/relevant discipline with evidence of published work; Associate Professor/Professor with total 15 years of teaching/research/administration experience; minimum API score as per PBAS (Appendix-III); minimum 10 research publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals; minimum 110 Research Score as per Appendix-II, Table-2 (UGC guideline 18.07.2018).

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Minimum API score based on PBAS as set in Appendix-III for direct recruitment of principals in colleges. Minimum of 10 research publications in peer reviewed or UGC listed journals. Minimum of 110 Research Score as per Appendix-II at Table-2 (UGC guideline 18.07.2018).

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Incomplete or erroneous applications will be rejected at scrutiny and no call letter will be issued.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Interview. Eligible candidates are called for interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The term of Principal shall be 5 years as per Govt. guidelines.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Suren Das College (Autonomous), Hajo, Kamrup, Assam.
